title: brain.request body v1
description: Explicit request to the brain. In Phase 1 jv-brain ALSO consumes audio.transcript finals directly (voice path); this topic exists for non-voice frontends (jv CLI, replay harness, later the HUD). Command topic: envelope conf = 1.0.

source.description: Where this input came from. 'system' is reserved for internally generated prompts (proactivity, Phase 4+).

conversation_id.description: Rolling-context thread. Omitted = the default conversation.

utterance_id.description: When source=voice: the audio.transcript utterance this text came from.

speak.description: Whether the response should also be published as speech.say (false for silent/CLI queries).
